title: Euclean: Automated Geometry Problem Formalization with Unified Verification in Lean
authors_zh: Linbin Tang, Jingyan You, Zilin Kang, Hanzhang Liu, Sophia Zhang, Zenan Li, Chenrui Cao, Liangcheng Song, Jiaao Wu, Xian Zhang, Fan Yang
paper_type_zh: 可程序化验证的推理数据或基准
best_for_zh: 需要可复现结果验证的推理数据研究者。
one_line: One-sentence position:** Hundreds of thousands of natural-language geometry problems are formalized in native Mathlib and verified uniformly by Lean.
把十万级自然语言几何题形式化到原生 Mathlib，并用 Lean 统一验证。
why: It exposes a reproducible terminal outcome check rather than only a textual reference.
inclusion_reason: The released resource exposes a reusable programmatic outcome-verification surface.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Advanced mathematical-reasoning systems use Lean for algebra and number theory, while geometry often relies on domain-specific languages and external solvers. This enlarges the trusted computing base and prevents unified training. Native Mathlib formalization must explicitly encode non-degeneracy, positional, and topological assumptions, yet previous datasets contain fewer than roughly 1,100 problems.

Euclean applies a four-stage autoformalization and unified Lean verification pipeline to convert natural-language plane geometry into native Mathlib theorems and releases large-scale statements plus proof attempts.

高水平数学推理系统在代数、数论中可使用 Lean，但几何仍常依赖专用语言和外部求解器，扩大 trusted computing base，也阻碍统一训练。原生 Mathlib 几何形式化还必须显式写出图形中的非退化、位置和拓扑假设，现有数据不足千题，无法支撑大规模学习。

Euclean 用四阶段自动形式化与 Lean 统一验证，把自然语言平面几何转换为原生 Mathlib 定理，并公开大规模 statement 与部分 proof 数据。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: The paper constructs 768 OMNI-Geometry and 177,597 Numina-Geometry items. The current regenerated official releases contain 780 and 183,796 records respectively, using Lean/Mathlib 4.28.0 and Codex GPT-5.4. Numina records include informal statements, proofs, answers, provenance, and formal_statement; Omni additionally stores formal_proof and a completion flag, with 525 of 780 one-pass proofs completed. The Parquet data are Apache-2.0, but compilation guarantees formal well-formedness rather than semantic faithfulness.

论文版本构建 OMNI-Geometry 768 题与 Numina-Geometry 177,597 题；当前官方重生成发布分别为 780 条和 183,796 条，使用 Lean/Mathlib 4.28.0 与 Codex GPT-5.4。Numina 记录含非形式陈述、证明、答案、来源与 formal_statement；Omni 还含 formal_proof 和完成标记，525/780 个一次证明通过。数据以 Parquet、Apache-2.0 发布，但编译只保证形式语法成立，不自动保证语义忠实。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Explicate geometric constraints: Recover implicit collinearity, non-degeneracy, point-order, and region conditions so the task can be expressed in native Mathlib.
  1. Anchor configurations: Construct stable point, line, circle, and coordinate configurations to prevent degenerate assignments from making the theorem trivial.
  1. Map to Lean statements: Map objects, assumptions, and conclusions to Mathlib definitions and lemmas, generate theorem statements, and compile them under a fixed version.
  1. Iteratively repair and prove: Use Lean diagnostics to fix types and assumptions; for the Omni subset, generate a one-pass proof and record whether the Lean kernel accepts it.

1. 显式化几何约束： 从题目与图形语义中补全共线、非退化、点序和区域关系等隐含条件，使目标可在原生 Mathlib 中表达。
  1. 锚定构型： 建立稳定的点、线、圆及坐标配置，避免模型通过退化赋值使定理平凡成立。
  1. 映射 Lean 陈述： 将自然语言对象、条件和结论映射到 Mathlib 定义与 lemma，生成 theorem statement 并在固定版本编译。
  1. 迭代修复与证明： 根据 Lean 错误反馈修正类型和假设；对 Omni 子集进一步生成一次 proof，并以 Lean 内核是否接受记录完成标签。

title: Evidence
证据
html: Human evaluation reports semantic formalization accuracy of 48.89% at TOP1 and 73.33% at TOP5. Training Goedel-Prover-V2 on the formalizations raises geometry proof success from 13.6% to 15.1%, and 525 of 780 one-pass proofs compile in the current Omni release. These results support downstream utility but also show that roughly half of top-ranked statements may remain semantically wrong; compilation rate is not formalization accuracy.
人工评测显示自动形式化 TOP1 语义正确率为 48.89%，TOP5 为 73.33%。用这些形式化数据训练 Goedel-Prover-V2 后，几何证明成功率从 13.6% 提升到 15.1%；当前 Omni 发布中 525/780 个一次 proof 可编译。结果支持数据能改进统一 prover，但也表明约半数首选 statement 仍可能语义错误，不能把编译率当作形式化准确率。

title: Novelty
新意
html: LeanEuclid, LeanGeo, and related work use custom axioms or DSLs to bypass limitations of Mathlib geometry. Euclean instead explicates implicit diagram assumptions and verifies statements and proofs in native Mathlib at hundred-thousand scale. The novelty is the combination of native Mathlib, anti-degeneracy configuration anchoring, and large-scale data, rather than autoformalization itself.
LeanEuclid、LeanGeo 等工作通过自定义几何公理或 DSL 回避 Mathlib 几何库的限制。Euclean 的实际变化是把隐含图形条件显式化，并在原生 Mathlib 中统一完成 statement 与 proof 验证，同时扩展到十万级。新意不是首次自动形式化，而是 native-Mathlib、构型防退化和大规模数据三者结合。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
1. Semantic faithfulness: Lean compilation proves type correctness only; wrong or overly strong assumptions may also compile. Expert sampling and semantic-accuracy reporting are required.
  1. Version sensitivity: Mathlib geometry APIs evolve quickly. The release is tied to 4.28.0 and must be recompiled and repaired after upgrades.
  1. Domain boundary: The data focus on plane olympiad geometry and provide limited coverage of synthetic geometry, 3D geometry, or image-measurement tasks.

1. 语义忠实度： Lean 编译只证明 statement 类型正确；错误或过强假设也能编译。使用时应抽样专家复核，并报告语义准确率而非只报 compile rate。
  1. 版本敏感： Mathlib 几何 API 仍快速变化。数据绑定 4.28.0，升级后需重新编译并修复，不能假设长期可运行。
  1. 领域边界： 数据集中于平面竞赛几何，对合成几何、三维和含图像测量任务的覆盖有限；训练收益不能直接外推。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
1. Autoformalization training: Train informal-to-Lean models on the 183,796 Numina statements and evaluate both compilation and human semantic accuracy.
  1. Geometry-proof curriculum: Train a prover on compilable statements, then use Omni proof-completion labels for curricula and rejection sampling.
  1. Unified-verifier research: Compare native Mathlib with geometry DSLs in trusted base, semantic errors, and proof success, recompiling the corpus after Mathlib upgrades.

1. 自动形式化训练： 使用 183,796 条 Numina statement 训练 informal-to-Lean 模型，并以人工语义样本和 compile rate 双重评估。
  1. 几何证明课程： 先在可编译 statement 上训练 prover，再使用 Omni 的 proof-completed 标签按难度组织课程和 rejection sampling。
  1. 统一 verifier 研究： 比较原生 Mathlib 与几何 DSL 的 trusted base、语义错误和证明成功率；若升级 Mathlib，先全量重编译。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. One-sentence position: Hundreds of thousands of natural-language geometry problems are formalized in native Mathlib and verified uniformly by Lean.
  1. Method hook: Constraint explication, configuration anchoring, Lean mapping, and compiler-guided repair are the four core stages.
  1. Data hook: Current releases contain 183,796 Numina and 780 Omni records; 525 Omni one-pass proofs complete.
  1. Evidence anchor: TOP1/TOP5 semantic accuracy is 48.89%/73.33%, and prover success rises from 13.6% to 15.1%.
  1. Reuse decision: Use it for native-Lean geometry training only after separating compilation from semantic correctness.

1. 一句话定位： 把十万级自然语言几何题形式化到原生 Mathlib，并用 Lean 统一验证。
  1. 方法抓手： 约束显式化、构型锚定、Lean 映射和编译反馈修复是四个核心步骤。
  1. 数据抓手： 当前 Numina 183,796 条、Omni 780 条；Omni 有 525 个一次证明完成。
  1. 证据锚点： TOP1/TOP5 语义准确率为 48.89%/73.33%，prover 成功率 13.6%→15.1%。
  1. 复用决定： 适合 native-Lean 几何训练；必须区分“可编译”和“语义正确”。
